# Sianotte Design Studio

> Paris-based design engineer studio founded and run by Anastasiia Sianotte (Sia). Creative websites and digital products for ambitious brands, from first sketch to launch.

## About Anastasiia Sianotte

- Design engineer based in Paris, France: designs and builds, so one person takes a project from concept to live product.
- Designer since 2015, with a background in branding, web design, UI/UX, packaging, presentations and Shopify development.
- Runs Sianotte Design Studio solo and works with clients worldwide.
- Content creator in the design and AI space on Instagram (@sianotte.design), sharing workflows, tools and AI for designers.
- Has collaborated as a creator with design and AI brands including Adobe, Figma, ElevenLabs, Cursor, Replit, Anything, Fish Audio and Luma AI.

## Services

- Website design and development (Shopify, Framer and other platforms)
- E-commerce stores and Shopify theme work
- UI/UX design for web and digital products
- Branding and visual identity

Focus industries: e-commerce, Web3 and fintech.

## Brands worked with

Adobe, Figma, ElevenLabs, Cursor, Replit, Anything, Fish Audio, Luma AI, KIASA, Growfit, SailoTech, 8Blocks, Kajimono, Titan Partners, Blissful Plans, Settler.
